body.statement:
For any two probability measures \(\mu,\nu\) on \(\mathcal Y\),
\[
 W_1(\mu,\nu)
 =\sup\left\{\int_{\mathcal Y} f\,d(\mu-\nu):
       f:\mathcal Y\to\mathbb R,\ |f(y)-f(y')|\leq\lVert y-y'\rVert_2\right\}
 =\lVert\mu-\nu\rVert_{\mathrm{KR}}.
\]

source.locator: Section 1, displayed dual form of Wasserstein-1 in the prior-work discussion
source.verbatim_statement: \(W_1(\mu,\nu)=\sup_{f\in\mathrm{Lip}}\int f(\mathrm d\mu-\mathrm d\nu)\), where the supremum is over all one-Lipschitz functions.
